title: Renew a charitable fundraising authority
summary: This page provides information on how to renew a charitable fundraising authority.
intro: The maximum term of an authority to fundraise is 5 years. You can apply to renew your authority before it expires, or up to 3 months after the expiry date.
who_can_apply: Must be the holder of a charitable fundraising authority or be authorised by the authority holder.
what_you_need: Your charitable fundraising authority number (CFN) which must match the registered number.
A charitable fundraising authority that has not expired or expired less than 3 months ago.

To renew the authority, you need to follow the steps: Select 'Renew online', log in using your MyServiceNSW Account, follow the prompts, download and complete the 'Charitable fundraising authority – renewal – PDF' form, sign the declaration, attach supporting documents, and email your information to the address on the form.

how_to_steps.text: You'll have the option to log in using your MyServiceNSW Account.
Follow the prompts to renew the charitable fundraising authority.
Download Charitable fundraising authority – renewal – PDF.
Email your information to the address on the form.

contact: If you have any questions about a charitable fundraising authority email NSW Fair Trading or call 13 32 20.

more_info.text: For more information go to the NSW Fair Trading Charitable Fundraising Guidelines.

faqs.q: How long is the maximum term for a fundraising authority?
faqs.a: The maximum term of an authority to fundraise is 5 years.

faqs.q: When can I renew my charitable fundraising authority?
faqs.a: You can apply to renew your authority before it expires, or up to 3 months after the expiry date.

faqs.q: Who can apply to renew the authority?
faqs.a: You must be the holder of a charitable fundraising authority or be authorised by the authority holder.
